verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Unleash lets you enable and disable features without redeploying, and SDKs connect at runtime, optionally through Edge, which acts as a read replica serving thousands of connected SDKs. Nothing in the pack describes streaming, polling intervals or how fast changes propagate, so the kill-switch latency claim is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of streaming or fast-polling delivery to SDKs, stated propagation latency (seconds), kill-switch behavior in connected SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
